test_captured_output: test the pybind11 iostream module by capturing C++ stdout output to Python via capsys
test_ostream_redirect: test the pybind11 ostream_redirect context manager to redirect C++ stdout and stderr to Python StringIO
test_captured_err: test the pybind11 iostream module by capturing C++ stderr output to Python via capsys
test_flush_behavior: test the pybind11 noisy_function flush behavior to verify buffered vs flushed C++ output
test_raw_output: test the pybind11 raw_output and raw_err functions to verify unredirected C++ stream output
